intro.text: Scholars who predict the coming of highstorms, using complex mathematics written in a glyph-based script.

description.text: They also study the seasons and other storm-related subjects, finding for example that plants grow better with storm water than with lake or river water.

Vorins find stormwardens strange and distasteful, since their work touches two taboos: predicting the future and men writing. Their predictions are too useful to forbid, and they write with an adapted glyph script.
Stormwardens predict highstorms from the timing of recent storms, previous years' storms, and when the last storm left western Roshar. Their predictions aren't perfect but are very useful.
Some dabble in less scientific practices, like digitology, or predicting the future from the winds or candle smoke.
Many work for rulers and nobles, who plan events and battles around their predictions; others travel, selling lists of predicted storm dates.

items.text: When Hesina suggested young Kaladin could become a stormwarden, he reacted with disgust at predicting the future, though studying the winds held some appeal.
